parsed.name: kuando Busylight USB忙闲指示灯
parsed.description: 一种通过USB连接的kuando Busylight桌面状态指示灯，通常具有RGB发光和提示音功能，可用于实验室或工位场景中的状态显示、流程提醒和可视化告警。
parsed.description_en: A USB-connected kuando Busylight desktop status indicator, typically with RGB illumination and audible alert capability, used in labs or workstations for status indication, workflow prompts, and visual notifications.
